must_identify.item: The kubelet is restarting the container because the liveness probe fails
must_identify.evidence: Pod events on api-c7b987b4d-8xv5k: Warning Unhealthy ... Liveness probe failed: dial tcp 10.244.1.39:8081: connect: connection refused → Normal Killing ... Container api failed liveness probe, will be restarted → container terminated with Exit Code: 137 (SIGKILL from kubelet).

must_identify.item: The probe targets port 8081 while the app listens on 8080
must_identify.evidence: the new revision changed the container's liveness probe port from 8080 to 8081, while the app only ever listens on port 8080.

notes: The RCA explicitly rules out OOM and application crash, and it recommends reverting the probe port to 8080 instead of removing the probe. The JSON patch path in the rendered command is wrapped/truncated ('htt et'), so a reviewer should confirm the actual path is livenessProbe/httpGet/port.
